northStar.title: Your North Star
northStar.subtitle: The one thing you are working towards.
northStar.explain: A North Star is a long-term goal that gives your days a direction: finishing a book, building a calm team, changing careers. One is enough.

milestones.title: Milestones on the way
milestones.subtitle: The steps between here and there.
milestones.explain: Three to five steps are plenty. You can link todos and time blocks to them later, and see how much of your week served your North Star.

tips.text: Pick the one thing that would make today feel good.
It's okay to say “not this quarter”.
Link a todo to a milestone to see your week line up with your North Star.
Connect an AI in Settings and these messages will be about your own days.
“Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.” — Lao Tzu

ai.title: AI
ai.subtitle: A local model (LM Studio, Ollama) or a cloud API. Optional.
ai.baseUrlHelp: LM Studio on this computer: http://localhost:1234/v1. From Docker: http://host.docker.internal:1234/v1.
ai.apiKeyHelp: Not needed for LM Studio or Ollama. Stored encrypted.

errors.ai_key_rejected: The AI refused the API key.
errors.ai_not_found: The AI doesn't know this address or model.
errors.ai_provider_error: The AI answered with an error. The server log has the details.
errors.ai_invalid_answer: The model's answer wasn't in the expected shape. Try a larger model (7B or more).

hoshinKanri.name: Hoshin Kanri
hoshinKanri.applied: Your North Star is the “True North”. Milestones are the steps on the path. Todos and time blocks can link to a milestone, so you can see how much of your week served your North Star.
hoshinKanri.adapted: Simplified for one person: one North Star and its milestones, no strategy matrix, no team cascade. Links are optional.
